AND THE MECHANISM MAKES WIDENING FUTILE, NOT MERELY UNWISE: those tests load the file by slicing its source string through vm.runInThisContext, and c8 instruments the require/import graph -- so c8 reports 0/0 EVEN IF the file is forced into --include (measured 2026-08-03). The file is not ungated either; its real gate is the behavioural suite under src/tests/unit/notifications_js/ plus the :8000 Playwright E2E. HOW I GOT IT WRONG: I ran `grep -c notifications` over lines 198-213 ONLY -- the --include flag block -- got 0, and published a conclusion about the whole 250-line script. I named a 16-line population and reported a fact about a file. That is this repo's own AN EMPTY RESULT IS TWO DIFFERENT FAILURES WEARING ONE FACE, committed by someone who cited that section to two peers the same evening. What survives is arithmetic that is correct and not news: the unmeasured JS layer is larger than the measured corpus, which is the documented and ruled state with a stated forward direction (extract new logic into importable TS so the legacy surface shrinks). No action falls out of it. Dropped rather than wont_fix because there is no defect here to decline -- there was never a defect.
